architecture.family: pure SSM (Mamba-3), ZERO attention layers -- attn_layer_idx=[] in config, confirmed

architecture.mlp: gated MLP per block (d_model<->d_intermediate, exact gate/up/down split not read from a safetensors index -- this specimen ships as a single pickled state_dict, not sharded safetensors, so no per-tensor manifest was cheaply available for this pass)

state_structure.kv_cache: NONE -- zero attention layers, no KV concept applies at all
state_structure.conv_state_contribution: NOT COMPUTED -- config.json's ssm_cfg has NO d_conv key (has_d_conv=False). Mamba2-family models typically declare one; Mamba3-SISO here does not, so either the short-conv step is architecturally absent/changed in Mamba3, or it uses an undeclared default this pass does not assume. SCAR: an EARLIER computation this same session (the A5 SSM-crossover transfer test) silently hardcoded d_conv=4 for this exact specimen without checking -- that number was UNVERIFIED and should be treated as such if referenced.
state_structure.note: the CONFIRMED (conv-free) state is constant regardless of context length (the defining SSM property, per this session's A5/O001 finding, R-ssm-state-vs-kv-crossover -- this specimen is the rule's limit case: crossover is infinite since there is no KV term at all). Total state (with whatever conv contribution actually exists) would be somewhat larger than the confirmed figure but is still expected to be a small fraction of the 2.78GB weight store either way.

context_capability.assessment: SHORT by current standards (most 2026 models: 8K-128K+). A real, notable bottleneck -- not something Gravity/quantization fixes; it is a training-time property. Relevant directly to Star/Resident evaluation below: HCLI's own working-set prompts (objective + plan + evidence, measured this session at several hundred to a few thousand chars even after compaction) would plausibly not fit comfortably, let alone a real multi-file repo context. Disqualifying for Resident candidacy AS-IS without a context-extension pass.

execution_feasibility_this_machine.assessment: trivially small footprint (2.78 GiB) vs 96GB unified memory -- loading this specimen would not remotely approach the swap/memory-pressure concerns that gated other campaign work. No GPU/mlx load attempted this pass (S002/S003: do not contend with the active HCLI resident for cheap Odyssey work; this specimen is small enough that a future load would be a short, low-risk YIELD window when one is next taken for a real reason).

obvious_representation_opportunities: Pure-SSM state (~24 MiB confirmed, conv contribution unverified but plausibly similar order) is already tiny relative to the 2.78GB weight store (<1%) -- Gravity leverage here is almost entirely in the WEIGHT bytes (dense SSM projections + gated MLP), not the state. This is the OPPOSITE profile from a hybrid/MoE specimen where organ-heterogeneous allocation (this session's new rule) has a large lever -- there is no 'protect one organ, push another' split available since there is no MoE/attention organ to differentiate against.

The gated MLP (d_model<->d_intermediate, 2048<->4096) is architecturally IDENTICAL in shape to a standard dense-transformer MLP block -- existing dense-architecture Gravity priors (cross-layer/cross-block structure search, per S005) plausibly transfer here more directly than any MoE-derived rule.

No baseline TPS/prefill/decode measurement yet (same gate).

Tokenizer is an EXTERNAL dependency (meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B, gated HF repo) not co-located with the weights -- acquisition of a servable copy needs that tokenizer resolved first, a genuine acquisition step distinct from the weights already being on disk.
preliminary_disposition: RESEARCH SPECIMEN (Odyssey I only, not yet a Gravity/NX/Odyssey III candidate). Genuinely fills an architecture-diversity gap (pure SSM, zero attention -- the R-ssm-state-vs-kv-crossover rule's own limit case, now with a real specimen instead of just the formula's degenerate branch). Small footprint makes a future capability-battery pass cheap WHEN a GPU window opens. Context length (2048) is a real, honest limitation for Resident candidacy specifically -- flagged, not hidden.
